therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: IL-2 receptor agonism with preferential CD8+ T cell and NK cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced anti-tumor immune response through selective T cell and NK cell stimulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Dose-limiting toxicities and objective response rate

results.effect_size: ORR 13/75 (17.3%) for NKTR-214 0.006 mg/kg + pembrolizumab cohort
subgroup_findings: ORR varied by dose: 13/75 responses at 0.006 mg/kg dose, 2/17 responses at 0.010 mg/kg dose
Combination with chemotherapy showed 2 responses in dose expansion cohorts 4/5
safety_signals: Single DLT of hypotension at 0.010 mg/kg dose
High rate of serious infections including pneumonia, sepsis, UTI
6/18 patients discontinued due to adverse events in dose optimization cohort
No treatment-related deaths in dose optimization cohort
results.dose_information: NKTR-214 doses: 0.006-0.012 mg/kg IV q3w, pembrolizumab 200 mg, with or without platinum-based chemotherapy
